title: C# Variables Pro
description: Advanced variable concepts: constants, multiple declarations, and identifiers.
example:
const int myNum = 15;
int x = 5, y = 6, z = 50;

challenges.title: Constants
challenges.exercise: Create a constant int 'minutesPerHour' and set it to 60. Print it.

challenges.title: Multiple Variables
challenges.exercise: Declare x, y, z as int in one line. Assign x=1, y=2, z=3. Print their sum.
challenges.solution:
int x = 1, y = 2, z = 3;
Console.WriteLine(x + y + z);
